description: Independent thirty-case pilot; no expected claims supplied to normal retrieval or writer. Family clustering must be reported.

questions: For a new NYC apartment building under the 2022 code, what is the minimum ceiling height in an ordinary habitable living room? No basement, mezzanine or beam exception applies.
checks: 8 feet; measured finished floor to underside of ceiling. Do not give generic 7 ft 6 in as the habitable-room minimum.

questions: Under the 2022 NYC Building Code, is 0.5 footcandle sufficient for normal illumination of an ordinary office exit-access corridor? There is no performance or existing photoluminescent-system exception.
checks: No; at least 1 footcandle at walking surface. Do not confuse emergency average/minimum illumination with normal illumination.

questions: For an ordinary elevated terrace in a new NYC office building, a fixed bench is 12 inches horizontally from the guard. From where is the required guard height measured, and what height is required?
checks: 42 inches from uppermost bench surface because fixed seating is within 21 inches; not merely from floor.

questions: For an ordinary public terrace guard under the 2022 NYC Building Code, may an opening 20 inches above the walking surface allow a 5-inch sphere through? No special occupancy or stair exception applies.
checks: No; 4-inch sphere limitation. Upper 36-to-42-inch zone exception does not apply at 20 inches.

questions: A new NYC office building has a 48-inch-wide ordinary stairway. Are handrails required on both sides? It is not an aisle, dwelling-unit stair or spiral stair.
checks: Yes both sides; do not apply the less-than-44-inch enclosed-stair exception.

questions: Under the 2022 NYC Plumbing Code, what minimum slope and total fall are required for a straight 40-foot horizontal run of 4-inch sanitary drainage pipe?
checks: 1/8 inch per foot; 5 inches fall, uniform slope.

questions: Can ordinary horizontal sanitary-drain cleanouts be spaced 120 feet apart in a new NYC building? This is not the nonremovable-fixture-trap exception.
checks: No; intervals no more than 100 feet.

questions: Is a 1.5-inch liquid trap seal acceptable for an ordinary plumbing fixture under the 2022 NYC Plumbing Code?
checks: No; ordinary liquid seal 2 to 4 inches; special deeper-seal exception cannot justify shallower seal.

questions: Does the NYC Plumbing Code hose-outlet vacuum-breaker requirement apply to a threaded boiler drain connection intended only for draining the boiler?
checks: That specific connection is excepted; do not generalize exception to ordinary hose bibbs.

questions: For an ordinary non-accessible toilet compartment in NYC, is 14 inches from the water-closet centerline to a side wall sufficient?
checks: No; minimum 15 inches centerline to side wall. Do not substitute accessible compartment dimensions as the ordinary minimum.

questions: For attic HVAC access under the 2022 NYC Mechanical Code, can a 30-foot passageway use the exception if it is clear 6 feet high and 24 inches wide along its entire length? Address the length condition, not a blanket installation approval.
checks: Yes length exception permits up to 50 feet for that clear height/width; other access/service requirements remain.

questions: What minimum condensate drain diameter does the 2022 NYC Mechanical Code table require for a manifold serving 30 tons of refrigeration capacity?
checks: 1 inch; 3/4 inch baseline alone is insufficient for over20 through40 tons.

questions: For the control side of an ordinary HVAC appliance under the 2022 NYC Mechanical Code, what minimum level working-space dimensions are required?
checks: 30 inches deep by30 inches wide; electrical clearances may additionally apply.

questions: In a NYC garage, can an ordinary heater ignition source be 12 inches above the floor? Assume it is not listed as flammable-vapor-ignition resistant.
checks: No; ignition source at least18 inches above floor; FVIR exception excluded.

questions: A rooftop HVAC unit needs servicing 9 feet from an open roof edge with a 36-inch drop. Under the NYC Mechanical Code guard rule, is a guard required and how high?
checks: Yes within10 feet and drop over30 inches; guard42 inches high; if added, extends30 inches beyond each equipment end and21-inch sphere opening limit.

questions: Under the 2022 NYC Fuel Gas Code ordinary appliance rule, may an accessible shutoff valve be in the same room but 8 feet from the appliance? No exception applies.
checks: No; within6 feet, same room; upstream of connector/union if mentioned.

questions: Can I join two 3-foot gas appliance connectors to obtain a 6-foot connection under the 2022 NYC Fuel Gas Code?
checks: No; only one connector per appliance although maximum overall length6 feet.

questions: For NYC gas distribution piping proposed to operate at 8 psig, what minimum pressure and duration are required by the over-5-psig pressure-test rule?
checks: At least2xMAOP but minimum100 psig, at least1hour; hence100psig and1hour, not12psig.

questions: Under the ordinary 2022 NYC Fuel Gas Code pressure-test duration rule, is 10 minutes enough? Assume no provision requires a longer special test.
checks: No; minimum halfhour/30minutes, after stabilization when stated.

questions: For underground gas pipe in NYC with no special protective steel plate, is the 24-inch minimum burial depth measured to the pipe centerline or top of pipe?
checks: Top of pipe; not centerline. Do not substitute18in.

questions: Under the 2022 NYC Fire Code, is it enough to clean combustible rubbish from an open yard only after it catches fire or obstructs an exit?
checks: No;304.1.1 regular cleaning to prevent accumulation, and304.1 prohibits accumulation.

questions: Under the 2022 NYC Fire Code, how much storage clearance is required below sprinkler head deflectors? Assume ordinary storage and no department-authorized exception.
checks: At least18 inches measured below deflectors;315.2.1, not315.3.1; do not measure from ceiling.

questions: Can a delivery truck park in a designated NYC fire lane if its driver stays inside?
checks: No;503.4 prohibits parking; driver presence does not create an exception. Do not invent timed unloading allowance.

questions: An automatic fire-door hold-open device is out of service for repair. Under the NYC Fire Code, should the door remain open or closed during repairs?
checks: Closed;703.2.2; no wedging open.

questions: Under the NYC Fire Code, how should oily waste rags susceptible to spontaneous ignition be stored, and how often must the container contents be removed?
checks: Listed disposal container; remove and dispose daily;304.3.1.

questions: Under NYC ZR25-811, how many bicycle spaces does an ordinary new residential building with11 dwelling units require? It is not affordable senior housing, has no enclosed automobile parking, and no other waiver applies.
checks: 6;1 per2 units gives5.5 rounded up;ten-or-fewer-unit waiver does not apply.

questions: Under NYC ZR25-83, may I use8 square feet per required bicycle space without a Buildings Commissioner certification approving the layout?
checks: No; default15sf; reduction by up to9sf requires certification. Do not say minimum automatically9sf.

questions: Under NYC ZR25-84, is an ordinary off-site bicycle room on another zoning lot1,100 feet from the nearest boundary of the served zoning lot within the permitted distance? It is not a shared subsurface facility.
checks: No;1000feet maximum measured from nearest boundary, not entrance.

questions: Does NYC ZR32-41 automatically forbid every outdoor accessory use whenever a principal commercial use must be enclosed?
checks: No;accessory uses may be open or enclosed provided open accessory customarily found with principal; other restrictions may apply, no blanket approval.

questions: Under NYC ZR25-811, is an ordinary residential building containing exactly10 dwelling units eligible for the small-building bicycle-parking waiver? Assume no segment issue.
checks: Yes;10 or fewer waiver. Do not apply 1per2 requirement without waiver.
